# foundry_vector_store_file (Resource)

Attaches an existing file to a vector store so its contents are indexed for retrieval.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foundry_vector_store_file" "manual" {
  vector_store_id = foundry_vector_store.support.id
  file_id         = foundry_file.manual.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String) Identifier of the file to attach.
- `vector_store_id` (String) Identifier of the vector store the file is attached to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the file was attached.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned identifier of the attachment, which equals the file identifier.
- `status` (String) Indexing status of the attached file.
- `usage_bytes` (Number) Bytes the attached file contributes to the vector store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Vector store files are imported using the compound vector_store_id/file_id form.
terraform import foundry_vector_store_file.manual vs_abc/assistant-xyz
```
